note: It feels like this shot could be replaced with her yelling at somebody else. I like the way she's sort of pointing her finger at this guy. What would be classic is her in a coffee shop doing the same to a barrister, because this is the classic Karen scenario, like her complaining about a lack of service and can I speak to the manager in some kind of customer service scenario. I think that as these first few shots are really setting up the archetype in people's heads, we should really lean into that as opposed to this scene where she's just looking down at the phone.
